source: Generated with astcenc 4.7.0 (@gpu-tex-enc/astc), which is Arm's reference ASTC implementation: each vector was encoded with `astcenc -cl <png> <astc> <block> -exhaustive` and the expected RGBA is that file decoded back with `astcenc -dl`.

vectors.name: noise at 4x4
vectors.note: widest quantisation ranges and the most partitions

vectors.name: noise at 10x6
vectors.note: non-square block with a coarse weight grid

vectors.name: dualplane at 6x6
vectors.note: dual-plane blocks, where alpha has its own weights

vectors.name: flat at 4x4
vectors.note: constant-colour blocks, encoded as void extents

vectors.name: edges at 8x8
vectors.note: hard edges, so multi-partition with the partition hash

vectors.name: gradient at 12x12
vectors.note: largest block size, so the most weight infill
